page.layout: One printed page (left of the scan): a central column of italic verse with notes in the left margin; running head and page number at the top; catchword at the lower right. The right-hand page is blank apart from show-through, which is left out.

p.note: Vt coeperat, sic finem facit, epulandi Cardinalis sine vlla gratiarū actione ad Deum. Sic scil. Petrus & Paulus factitabant, sic ipse Dominus Iesus, cuius vicarium se gloriatur Romanus Papa cum suis Cardinalib.
p.i: Sic est post epulum locuta virgo:
Vides vt iaceant in orbe cuncta,
Id quod quemque suus monebat ardor,
Vt clausum ad superos iter pateret,
Fassi vnum coluere: sed quod ille
Nec omnes capiunt quod omnibus dat.
Vt peruersa hominum malignaq; est mens,

main_text.p: Hic suis nominibus designantur Cardinales virtutes Curiae Romanae, quam longè latéque patet eius synagoga.Versa in segnitiem fides, & omnis In quaestum pietas. Simul sequuta Miris illecebris placens voluptas. Nunquam delitiae superiores, Nunquam auaritiae altior Charybdis. Quando ita ambitio negotiata est?

page.notes: Faint mirrored show-through of notes from the reverse side (left margin, around the middle of the page) has been left out. The catchword "Quando" is printed at the lower right. The left-margin note placement is approximate, and marked reference signs in the verse are not clearly legible.
